name: katman-mcp

tools.name: katman_start
tools.description: Call this FIRST, and again after every step. Shows the Katman method (gates Read / Quote / Fit; steps Research → Plan → Build → Verify), the status of each step from .katman/ (research %, scan, audit, plan tasks, visibility runs, 14-day re-measure) and the NEXT STEP as an exact tool call with arguments — do that next. Pass project_root (absolute path of the site's codebase) and site_url when known; site_url is saved to .katman/config.json. Writes nothing else. Without a plan it only explains Katman, the plans and how to set the key. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

site_url.description: The live site URL, e.g. https://example.com (saved to .katman/config.json)

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_research
tools.description: Step 1. Creates and maintains .katman/research.json + research.md: brand, category, the one sentence in 4 parts (brings → weDo → gets → fear), not-X note, 10–12 unbranded customer situations, competitors (url + checkedAt), proof (with source), keywords, question set. mode template = skeleton; update = merge data (lists merge by id/name/sentence; replace_lists replaces); show = print with completeness % and warnings. generate_questions builds the question set per site language (12+2 for the primary). Fill from the codebase, ask the user for customer sentences; never invent. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

mode.description: Default: update when data/generate_questions is given, else show (or template when there's no research)

previewUrls.description: Preview/staging hosts that must redirect or be noindex

category.description: What it is, e.g. "AI invoice scanner"

notX.description: What it's NOT confused with (ask ChatGPT "What is <brand>?"), or "none"

sentence.description: Optional hand-written final one sentence (else composed from oneLiner)

pricing.description: Exactly as on the pricing page

sentence.description: The customer's own sentence, no brand name

url.description: The competitor's own page the facts come from

replace_lists.description: Replace the lists given in data instead of merging (also allows regenerating the question set)

generate_questions.description: Build the 12 + 2 question set from research (book ch. 15) in the site's primary language

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_plan
tools.description: Step 2. Builds .katman/plan.md + plan.json from research, scan.json, the latest audit and runs: the page plan (existing vs missing pages), what stays out of the index (noindex vs robots.txt Disallow), and the first-30-days task list (P-code, files, acceptance criterion, verifying tool; critical findings first). Ticks in plan.md are kept when it regenerates. Show the plan to the user and get approval before changing code. Re-run after new scans or audits. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_prompt
tools.description: Step 3. Returns prompt P0–P14 from the Katman prompt book filled with this project's research (brand, domain, one sentence, not-X, competitors, situation) plus Accept (acceptance criterion), Why, how Katman verifies it (exact tool call) and framework notes from scan.json. Do the prompt, list the changed files, run the check; tick the task in .katman/plan.md only when it passes. P6 takes situation_id. Unknown values stay [FILL] — ask, don't guess. Read-only. (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

id.description: Prompt id: P0–P14 (P0 context, P1 audit, P2 text in HTML, P3 head tags, P4 robots/sitemap, P5 schema, P6 situation page, P7 comparison guide, P8 llms.txt, P9 images, P10 links, P11 404/redirects, P12 speed, P13 measurement, P14 pre-release check)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

situation_id.description: For P6: the situation id from research (s1, s2…)

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_page_brief
tools.description: Filled page brief before writing a page: URL, title (situation first, ≈60 chars), H1, first sentence, action, proof, not-for, alternatives, FAQ candidates, related pages, the 11-block anatomy, the JSON-LD to include (only information visible on the page) and where the file goes in this framework. type: situation | comparison | pricing | faq | about | single-question | glossary | tool | home. Use it before P6 / P7. Read-only. (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

situation_id.description: For type situation: the research situation id (default: the next one without a page)

topic.description: For comparison / single-question / tool: the topic, question or tool name

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_generate
tools.description: Generates from research (single source of truth): robots.txt (a group per AI bot, app paths closed with trailing slashes, auth pages left to noindex), llms.txt, Organization / WebSite / SoftwareApplication / FAQPage / BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, the AI-channel analytics snippet, a server-side bot counter, the IndexNow key file. Returns content + target path. write: true writes static files into the site's static dir (never over an existing file without overwrite: true) and code/JSON-LD into .katman/generated/; refuses while [FILL] remains. (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

app_paths.description: robots.txt: extra app paths to close, e.g. ["/app", "/account"]

training.description: robots.txt: AI training bots (default allow; search/user bots always allowed)

faq.description: faq-jsonld: the exact Q&A visible on the page

write.description: Write the file (static artifacts into the static dir; code and JSON-LD into .katman/generated/)

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file (review the diff first)

tools.name: katman_lint_content
tools.description: Checks one page against the Katman content rules before shipping: first 1–3 sentences answer (≤35 words, no preamble), key claim in the first ~200 chars, one sentence consistent with research + llms.txt, hype words, unsourced numbers, placeholders, "free" on a paid product, update date, FAQ 5–8, not-for and alternatives sections, ≥3 internal links, title/description length; comparison pages: sources + dates, own gaps, brand not first. Pass file (project path), url (live page, fetched without JS) or text. Read-only. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

file.description: Page source in the project (.md, .mdx, .html, .astro, .tsx, .jsx, .vue, .svelte, llms.txt), relative to project_root

url.description: A live page URL (fetched as bots see it, without JavaScript)

text.description: The page copy as Markdown/plain text

page_type.description: Default: situation when it matches a research situation, else other

situation_id.description: Research situation id the page is written for

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_report
tools.description: Writes .katman/report.md, a shareable summary: research completeness, the latest audit's gate pass rates (Read / Quote / Fit), AI visibility rates with changes vs the previous comparable run, the competitors named instead and the cited domains (off-site targets), plan progress, the top 10 open issues and the next 7 days. Use after a measurement or at the end of a work session. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase. Default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, then the client's workspace root, then the server's cwd.

lang.description: Output language: en or tr (default: .katman/config.json lang, else en).

tools.name: katman_scan_code
tools.description: Read-only scan of the project's code (no network). Detects framework and builder (Lovable/Bolt/v0/Replit), the rendering verdict (SSR/SSG/CSR + evidence), hosting and preview-URL patterns, public vs app/auth routes, robots/sitemap/llms.txt/404 (static or generated), head-tag source, JSON-LD, i18n, analytics/AI-channel tracking, onClick navigation, hash routing and images without alt. Never opens .env*, keys or secret files. Writes .katman/scan.json; returns findings with gate, P-code and acceptance criterion. Run it first, and after big code changes. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the website's codebase (default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, MCP roots, or cwd).

tools.name: katman_audit_site
tools.description: Fetches the live site without JavaScript, like AI crawlers: robots.txt, sitemap, http→https, www/apex, HSTS, compression, soft 404, llms.txt, AI-bot access through the CDN/firewall (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot…), and per page: status, noindex, title/description, canonical, H1, JS-off words and first paragraph, JSON-LD, og:image, hreflang, internal links. Returns gates, top-10 issues (P-codes + acceptance criteria) and the P14 table. Network: the site only, ≤4 requests at a time. Pass urls to re-verify a fix. Writes .katman/audits/<stamp>.json + .katman/audit.md. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

site_url.description: Site to audit, e.g. https://example.com (default: .katman/config.json siteUrl or research site.url).

max_urls.description: Max pages to fetch: homepage, its links and sitemap URLs (default 50).

urls.description: Quick verify mode: audit only these URLs (+ homepage and site-level checks).

include_bot_test.description: Test the homepage with each AI crawler user agent (default true).

preview_urls.description: Preview/staging copies (e.g. https://proj.vercel.app) that must 301 to the main host or send noindex.

tools.name: katman_indexnow
tools.description: Tells Bing (→ Copilot, ChatGPT search, DuckDuckGo), Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep about new or changed URLs via IndexNow. Creates a 32-hex key (saved in .katman/config.json), checks https://<host>/<key>.txt serves it, and selects only new/changed URLs (sitemap lastmod, else a hash of the page text) against .katman/indexnow.json. dry_run (default true) sends nothing; dry_run:false POSTs to api.indexnow.org and records the URLs. Always returns the manual checklist for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and Brave. (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

urls.description: Submit exactly these URLs instead of diffing the sitemap.

key.description: Existing IndexNow key (8–128 chars a-z A-Z 0-9 -); default: config or a new one.

dry_run.description: Default true: plan only. false = submit to api.indexnow.org.

tools.name: katman_keywords
tools.description: Expands a seed phrase with Google autocomplete (seed + a–z/0–9; ≤40 requests, 350 ms apart; network: suggestqueries.google.com only) into real search phrases, clustered, and marks single-question, situation and comparison page candidates (English and Turkish question words). Use during research to find the customer's own words. save:true merges them into .katman/research.json keywords (source "autocomplete"); otherwise nothing is written. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

seed.description: Seed phrase in the customer's words, e.g. "import invoices into accounting".

lang.description: Interface language (hl), default en; tr uses the Turkish alphabet.

expand.description: Expand with letters/digits (default true); false = one request.

save.description: Merge the candidates into research.json keywords.

tools.name: katman_visibility_run
tools.description: Asks the research question set (12 unbranded + 2 diagnostic) to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok via OpenRouter with live web search and the user's own key, then records who is named, recommended first and cited. SPENDS THE USER'S CREDITS: always call with dry_run: true first (the default), show the estimate, and get the user's explicit yes before dry_run: false. Default panel "economy" (5 assistants, smaller models, ≈$1–4 per run); "full" ≈$2–7; "probe" ≈$1–3. Refuses to start above max_cost_usd (default 3). A full run takes minutes. API answers are a proxy for the consumer apps. Saves .katman/runs/ and measurements.md. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project (default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, the client's MCP root, or cwd)

dry_run.description: Default true: estimate only, nothing is spent. false = real run, only after the user agreed to the estimate.

models.description: Preset "economy" (default: 5 assistants on smaller models), "full" (5 assistants on flagship models) or "probe" (ChatGPT + Perplexity); or a comma-separated list of family names (chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, grok) and OpenRouter slugs. .katman/config.json models override the default.

question_ids.description: Only ask these research question ids.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, default config.temperature or 0.7 (recorded; ignored by models that don't accept it).

judge.description: Default true: a cheap model extracts the recommended products in order; false = heuristics only.

follow_up_sources.description: Default false. When the brand is not named, ask "Which articles or pages did you use?" and add those URLs (your outreach list, book ch. 14).

max_cost_usd.description: Cost cap in USD, default 3. The run refuses to start when the expected cost is higher and stops starting calls at the cap.

samples.description: Ask each question × assistant this many times (default 1) to see how stable the answers are. Multiplies the cost.

allow_google_grounding.description: Gemini uses Exa search by default. true = Google's own grounding; Google's terms restrict storing and analysing grounded results, and the user is responsible.

tools.name: katman_manual_check
tools.description: No API cost, terms-safe measurement: the user asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok or Google AI Mode in a private, logged-out window with web search on and pastes the answer. Without answer_text: returns exact instructions and the questions to ask (verbatim). With answer_text (+ question_id or question, sources): detects whether the brand is named, its position, who was recommended, competitors and cited pages, saves a manual run in .katman/runs/ and updates measurements.md. Makes one tiny judge call only if an OpenRouter key is set. (Audit Week or Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project (default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, the client's MCP root, or cwd)

assistant.description: The consumer app the user asked.

question_id.description: Research question id that was asked (e.g. q1, t1).

question.description: The exact question asked, when it is not in the research question set.

answer_text.description: The full answer, pasted. Omit to get the instructions and the questions.

sources.description: The source links shown with the answer.

logged_in.description: Was the user signed in? Default false.

web_search.description: Was web search on? Default true.

tools.name: katman_setup_monitoring
tools.description: Generates a GitHub Actions workflow that re-runs the visibility check (and optionally the live site audit) on a schedule with the user's OPENROUTER_API_KEY repository secret, commits .katman/ changes and opens an issue when the mention rate drops. Returns the YAML, the estimated cost per run and month, and the steps to add the secret and site variable. Makes no network calls. write: true writes .github/workflows/katman.yml (refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite: true). (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project (default: KATMAN_PROJECT_ROOT, the client's MCP root, or cwd)

schedule.description: Cron (UTC), default "0 6 * * 1" (Mondays 06:00). The book re-measures every 14 days: "0 6 1,15 * *".

include_audit.description: Also run the live site audit each time (default true).

max_cost_usd.description: Per-run cap passed to katman-mcp check; default: the estimate's high end (at least 2).

models.description: Preset or comma list for the scheduled check, e.g. "economy" or "probe".

tools.name: katman_account
tools.description: Always works, even without a key. Shows the Katman plan behind KATMAN_KEY (none, Audit Week with the days left, or Katman Pro), the tools it unlocks, the account email (masked), when the key was last checked, and how to get a key or upgrade (the plans at katman.pro/pricing, with the exact MCP config snippet per editor). Checks the key with katman.pro at most once a day; refresh: true re-checks now (e.g. right after buying). Never shows the key.

refresh.description: Re-check the key with katman.pro now instead of using today's cached answer (e.g. right after buying or upgrading).

tools.name: katman_sync
tools.description: Sends this project's progress to the user's katman.pro dashboard: name and domain, gate pass counts from the latest audit, visibility rates by assistant and language from the latest run, plan progress, the top 10 issue titles, dates and the Katman version. Never code, file contents, AI answers, questions or prompts. dry_run (default true) shows the exact JSON and sends nothing; dry_run: false sends it and returns the dashboard link. (Katman Pro — needs KATMAN_KEY)

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project (where .katman/ lives).

dry_run.description: Default true: show the exact payload, send nothing. false = send it to katman.pro.

instructions:
Katman makes this project's public website readable, quotable and recommendable by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot) and findable in Google, Bing and Brave.

It follows the Katman method: 4 steps (1 Research → 2 Plan → 3 Build → 4 Verify) and 3 gates every public page must pass:
- Read: bots can reach the page (robots.txt, CDN/firewall) and its text is in the server HTML, not only in JavaScript.
- Quote: the first 1–3 sentences answer the question on their own, with the brand's one-sentence description.
- Fit: there is a page written for the situation the customer describes to the assistant.

Plans: every tool except katman_account needs KATMAN_KEY with an active plan in the MCP config.
- Audit Week ($3 for 7 days): katman_start, katman_research, katman_scan_code, katman_audit_site, katman_keywords, katman_plan, katman_lint_content, katman_visibility_run, katman_manual_check, katman_report. Audit and recommendations only: it never builds pages or writes site files.
- Katman Pro ($29/month founding price, or $290/year): all of the above plus katman_prompt (P0–P14), katman_page_brief, katman_generate, katman_indexnow, katman_setup_monitoring and katman_sync.
Without the right plan a tool returns a short explanation instead of running: pass it on to the user. katman_account always works and shows the plan, the days left and how to get a key.
Never try to bypass or work around the licence (no editing Katman's code or cache, no made-up keys).

How to work:
1. Always call katman_start first; it tells you the next step. Pass project_root (absolute path of the project) and site_url when you know them.
2. Never invent numbers, reviews, customers, competitor facts or claims. Write [FILL] and ask the user.
3. Never put information into schema, meta tags or llms.txt that is not visible on the page itself.
4. Only public pages. Don't touch login-only app screens.
5. After each change, list the files you changed. Don't call a task done until its Katman check passes (every prompt has an acceptance criterion).
6. katman_visibility_run spends the user's OpenRouter credits: run it with dry_run first, show the estimate, and get the user's OK. If your client times out during a run, the run keeps going in the background; results land in .katman/measurements.md. API answers are a proxy for the consumer apps; confirm key questions with katman_manual_check.
7. katman_sync sends only aggregates (gate counts, visibility rates, plan progress, issue titles) to the user's katman.pro dashboard: show its dry run first.
